digest.component_or_area: tickets store reclaim and epoch-guard transition
propositions: Operator-confirmed zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers must be attested before publication begins
A complete descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run with successful A6-0a ancestry must be recorded before the rewrite is pushed
The explicitly refreshed host rebar binary must pass an epoch-mismatch refusal probe before publication
Post-publication, old-tip non-ancestry and size-pack growth <1 MB must be verified after the first review-bot write
The identity.enforce_since value in rebar.toml must equal the commit-mapped post-rewrite SHA from the pre-window pin
Post-enable reconciliation must validate green via reconcile-bridge.yml run or operator-approved production-equivalent CLI with zero mutation/recovery failures and canary drift_total=0
